155409.title: Cottage with White Paling among Trees
155409.creator: Rembrandt van Rijn

editorial.note: Rembrandt drew this little house on the Spaarndammerdijk during one of his walks around Amsterdam. The drawing served as the starting point for the 1648 etching. There are a number of differences between the drawing and the print.

Rembrandt apparently drew this landscape on a bend in the Amstelveenseweg, southwest of Amsterdam. The building on the left is an inn, recognizable by the sign at the front. Only the black pen lines are original.
In Rembrandt’s time, the Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal was still an imposing canal. He stood here with his sketchbook, facing south.
